sessions.title: Across the Plateau
sessions.description: This thrilling documentary chronicles a group of determined long-distance cyclists from Guangzhou, China attempting an unprecedented physical feat: traversing the vast Tibetan Plateau entirely on pushbikes. Spanning more than 3,100 kilometres, this monumental Himalayan expedition encompasses five treacherous mountain passes, freezing sub-zero temperatures, and debilitating altitude sickness. Throughout their arduous journey, the riders confront extreme exhaustion and unpredictable weather that push their ageing bodies (the oldest cyclist is 66) and mental fortitude to the absolute limits. Mechanical breakdowns and isolation also test the interpersonal dynamics and camaraderie of the group as they battle to reach their goal. sessions.title: Fargo
sessions.description: In a desperate attempt to get himself out of a financial jam, mild-mannered Minnesota car salesman Jerry Lundegaard (William H. Macy) hires a pair of criminal lowlifes (Peter Stormare, Steve Buscemi) to kidnap his wife and demand a ransom from her wealthy father. Or at least that’s the plan – but it’s not long before their inept bungling leaves three people dead. Soon, heavily pregnant local police chief Marge Gunderson (Frances McDormand) begins diligently investigating the murders, as Jerry hopelessly attempts to cover his tracks. Released in 1996, this quirky and hilarious crime comedy quickly became the Coen Brothers’ biggest hit to date. It went on to win two Oscars, including McDormand’s first Best Actress trophy, and has even recently spawned an acclaimed TV spin-off series set in the same continuity. sessions.title: Blue Velvet
sessions.description: Returning home, college student Jeffrey Beaumont (Kyle MacLachlan) discovers a severed human ear discovered in an overgrown suburban field. He launches an amateur investigation alongside inquisitive teenager Sandy Williams (Laura Dern), which pulls them into a sinister criminal underworld. Their sleuthing leads them directly to troubled nightclub singer Dorothy Vallens (Isabella Rossellini), placing Jeffrey in the sights of Frank Booth (Dennis Hopper), a volatile, oxygen-inhaling psychopath who subjects Dorothy to horrific intimidation. Jeffrey soon discovers that disturbing perversions flourish beneath his quiet town's cheerful facade. sessions.title: Metropolis: Reconstructed & Restored
sessions.description: In the year 2026, wealthy industrialist's son Freder (Gustav Fröhlich) lives in luxury amidst a towering futuristic utopia until he discovers a subterranean world where impoverished labourers work to power the city. Inspired by the saintly Maria (Brigitte Helm) and her advocacy for equality and reform, Freder vows to help the workers, sparking a revolutionary chain of events that ultimately threatens the entire metropolis. Fritz Lang's landmark 1927 sci-fi masterpiece is perhaps the most influential silent film in history, having served as the inspiration for everything from Star Wars to The Matrix. And now, following the recent discovery in Argentina of crucial long-lost footage, Lang's complete dystopian epic can finally be experienced as originally intended when it first premiered 100 years ago.
